adjudication.rationale: The diff does change the POST /admin/groups parameter contract: Admin::GroupsController#create now reads top-level params[:name]/params[:visible] (and no longer params[:group][:name]/params[:group][:visible]/params[:group][:usernames]), while the JS client was updated accordingly (Group#asJSON now returns flat keys and Group#create posts that). This is a backwards-incompatible API change for any existing consumers still sending a nested `group: { ... }` payload. However, the specific claim of “silent corruption creating groups with blank names” is not directly verifiable from the diff because whether a blank name can be saved depends on Group model validations not shown here; the controller will at least route failures through `render_json_error` if `group.save` fails.
